document_header: Grilling Fire Safety Stay fire safe this summer! Follow these grilling safety tips. Only use your grill outside. Keep it at least 3 feet from siding, deck rails and eaves. Keep a 3-foot safe zone around your grill. This will keep kids and pets safe. Open your gas grill before lighting. Keep an eye on your grill, fire pit or patio torches. Don’t walk away from them when they are lit. Clean your grill after each use. This will remove grease that can start a fire.
